name: pi-crust
description: Run a structured SDLC of autonomous, specialist AI agents in your repo

scripts.lint: biome check apps lib runtime scripts templates
scripts.lint:fix: biome check apps lib runtime scripts templates --fix
scripts.test: bunt apps/visualizer lib runtime scripts | buntap --nyan
scripts.test:agent: CLAUDECODE=1 bunt apps/visualizer lib runtime scripts --coverage | buntap --agent
scripts.test:ci: CLAUDECODE=1 bun test apps/visualizer lib runtime scripts --coverage
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:runtime && bun run typecheck:harness && bun run typecheck:visualizer
